open('/kaggle/working/serve_shim.py', 'w').write("\nimport asyncio, json, os, time\nimport laya\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import JSONResponse\n\nBACKEND_ID = \"__BACKEND_ID__\"\nMODEL_NAME = \"laya-orig\"\n\nMODEL_DIR = open('/kaggle/working/model_dir.txt').read().strip()\nprint('loading model from', MODEL_DIR, flush=True)\nt0 = time.time()\nagent = laya.Agent(MODEL_DIR, device='cpu')\nprint(f'model loaded in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s', flush=True)\n\napp = FastAPI()\ngate = asyncio.Lock()\nSTATS = {\"requests\": 0, \"errors\": 0, \"total_ms\": 0.0}\nSTARTED = time.time()\n\n@app.get('/health')\nasync def health():\n    return {'ok': True, 'model_dir': MODEL_DIR}\n\n@app.get('/stats')\nasync def stats():\n    reqs = STATS[\"requests\"]\n    return {\"backend_id\": BACKEND_ID, \"model\": MODEL_NAME,\n            \"uptime_s\": round(time.time() - STARTED, 1),\n            \"requests\": reqs, \"errors\": STATS[\"errors\"],\n            \"avg_ms\": round(STATS[\"total_ms\"] / max(reqs, 1), 1)}\n\n@app.post('/v1/systemone')\nasync def systemone(request: Request):\n    body = await request.json()\n    questions = body.get('questions')\n    if not isinstance(body, dict) or not questions:\n        return JSONResponse({'error': \"body must be an object with 'questions'\"}, status_code=400)\n    state = body.get('state')\n    try:\n        async with gate:\n            t0 = time.perf_counter()\n            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()\n            result = await loop.run_in_executor(None, lambda: agent.predict(state, questions))\n            ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000\n    except Exception as e:\n        STATS[\"errors\"] += 1\n        return JSONResponse({'error': f'inference failed: {type(e).__name__}'}, status_code=500)\n    STATS[\"requests\"] += 1\n    STATS[\"total_ms\"] += ms\n    # Agent.predict returns {'answers': {...}, ...} already Jev-shaped; unwrap one level\n    answers = result.get('answers', result) if isinstance(result, dict) else result\n    return JSONResponse({'model': MODEL_NAME, 'answers': answers,\n                         'usage': {'inference_ms': round(ms, 1)}},\n                        headers={'X-Inference-Time-Ms': f'{ms:.1f}'})\n")
open('/kaggle/working/agent_py.py', 'w').write("#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Tunnel agent (Python port of agent.mjs): dials OUT to the Cloudflare Worker\nrelay via WebSocket and forwards bridged HTTP requests to a local target.\n\nUsage: agent_py.py --tunnel ID --secret SECRET --worker-host HOST --local-port PORT\nEnv fallback: TUNNEL_ID / TUNNEL_SECRET / WORKER_HOST / LOCAL_PORT.\n\"\"\"\nimport argparse, asyncio, base64, json, os, sys, time\nimport http.client\nimport websockets\n\ndef cfg(name, default=None):\n    return os.environ.get(name, default)\n\nasync def forward_to_local(msg, ws, local_port, timeout):\n    body = base64.b64decode(msg[\"body\"]) if msg.get(\"body\") else None\n    headers = dict(msg.get(\"headers\") or {})\n    headers.pop(\"content-length\", None)\n    if body:\n        headers[\"content-length\"] = str(len(body))\n    headers[\"host\"] = f\"127.0.0.1:{local_port}\"\n    headers[\"connection\"] = \"close\"\n    try:\n        conn = http.client.HTTPConnection(\"127.0.0.1\", local_port, timeout=timeout)\n        conn.request(msg.get(\"method\", \"GET\"), msg.get(\"path\", \"/\"), body=body, headers=headers)\n        res = conn.getresponse()\n        data = res.read()\n        out = {}\n        for k, v in res.getheaders():\n            lk = k.lower()\n            if lk in (\"transfer-encoding\", \"connection\"):\n                continue\n            out[lk] = v\n        frame = {\"t\": \"res\", \"id\": msg[\"id\"], \"status\": res.status,\n                 \"headers\": out, \"body\": base64.b64encode(data).decode()}\n    except Exception as e:\n        frame = {\"t\": \"res\", \"id\": msg[\"id\"], \"status\": 502,\n                 \"headers\": {\"content-type\": \"text/plain\"},\n                 \"body\": base64.b64encode(f\"local target unreachable: {e}\\n\".encode()).decode()}\n    if True:\n        try:\n            await ws.send(json.dumps(frame))\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\nasync def handle(ws, local_port, timeout):\n    async def pinger():\n        while True:\n            await asyncio.sleep(20)\n            try:\n                await ws.send(json.dumps({\"t\": \"ping\"}))\n            except Exception:\n                return\n    pt = asyncio.create_task(pinger())\n    try:\n        async for raw in ws:\n            if isinstance(raw, bytes):\n                continue  # TCP streams not used by the HTTP agent\n            try:\n                msg = json.loads(raw)\n            except Exception:\n                continue\n            if msg.get(\"t\") == \"req\":\n                asyncio.create_task(forward_to_local(msg, ws, local_port, timeout))\n    finally:\n        pt.cancel()\n\nasync def run(tunnel, secret, worker_host, local_port, timeout):\n    url = f\"wss://{worker_host}/agent/connect?tunnel={tunnel}\"\n    backoff = 1\n    proxy = os.environ.get(\"HTTPS_PROXY\") or os.environ.get(\"https_proxy\")\n    while True:\n        try:\n            print(f\"[agent] connecting to {worker_host} ...\", flush=True)\n            kw = {\"additional_headers\": {\"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {secret}\"}}\n            if proxy:\n                kw[\"proxy\"] = proxy\n            async with websockets.connect(url, **kw) as ws:\n                print(\"[agent] connected\", flush=True)\n                backoff = 1\n                await handle(ws, local_port, timeout)\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"[agent] disconnected ({e}), retry in {backoff}s\", flush=True)\n        await asyncio.sleep(backoff)\n        backoff = min(backoff * 2, 60)\n\ndef main():\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--tunnel\", default=cfg(\"TUNNEL_ID\"))\n    ap.add_argument(\"--secret\", default=cfg(\"TUNNEL_SECRET\"))\n    ap.add_argument(\"--worker-host\", default=cfg(\"WORKER_HOST\", \"tunnel-relay.ediprnm-keen.workers.dev\"))\n    ap.add_argument(\"--local-port\", type=int, default=int(cfg(\"LOCAL_PORT\", \"8000\")))\n    ap.add_argument(\"--timeout\", type=int, default=110)\n    a = ap.parse_args()\n    if not a.tunnel or not a.secret:\n        sys.exit(\"need --tunnel and --secret\")\n    asyncio.run(run(a.tunnel, a.secret, a.worker_host, a.local_port, a.timeout))\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n")

import threading, time as _time, json as _json, urllib.request as _urlreq
_BACKEND_ID = "__BACKEND_ID__"
_ALIAS = "laya-orig"
_MODEL = "laya-orig"
_INGEST_SECRET = "ad5a48aacd6a461826b0a823899abf4d0ca013b55940d93461b837ae882038eb"
_INGEST_URL = "https://laya.ediprnm-keen.workers.dev/ingest"
def _post_ingest(event):
    try:
        s = _json.loads(_urlreq.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/stats', timeout=10).read().decode())
    except Exception as e:
        print('ingest: local /stats failed:', type(e).__name__, flush=True)
        return
    body = _json.dumps({'backend_id': _BACKEND_ID, 'alias': _ALIAS, 'model': _MODEL,
                        'ts': int(_time.time()), 'event': event, 'stats': s}).encode()
    try:
        req = _urlreq.Request(_INGEST_URL, data=body,
                              headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                                       'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + _INGEST_SECRET,
                                       'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) laya-serve/1.0'})
        r = _urlreq.urlopen(req, timeout=30)
        print('ingest: %s -> %s' % (event, r.status), flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print('ingest: post failed:', type(e).__name__, flush=True)
def _ingest_loop():
    _post_ingest('boot')
    while True:
        _time.sleep(300)
        _post_ingest('stats')
_t = threading.Thread(target=_ingest_loop, daemon=True)
_t.start()
